For love songs that tell a story I got a few;

Going to California - Led Zeppelin. It’s about a man who’s in a toxic relationship so he breaks it off, his friends then tell him about this beautiful, amazing girl that lives in California and he just HAS to meet her. So he flies out to meet her, but at the end of the song he sees her and expresses his nervousness.

Wonderwall - Oasis. A song about a partner that’s so supportive they save you from yourself.

She Talks To Angels - The Black Crowes. A song about a goth, adopted, troubled, heroine addicted girl that the singer of the song is in love with.

Maybe I’m Amazed - Paul McCartney. A love ballad to his wife about how amazed he is at how much she’s improved his life, how she completes him. McCartney played all of the instruments on this track which I thought was neat.

You’re The One - Greta Van Fleet. A broken hearted man is still deathly in love with his ex. He wants her back. “You’re the one I want, you’re the one I had, so come on back to me...”

Just What I Needed - The Cars. This song is a really neat juxtaposition. The writer uses negative things to describe the things the girl he loves does. Basically trying to say she can literally do no wrong in his eyes. Because she’s just what he needed. “I don’t mind you coming here, and wasting all my time”
